source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bosch_Motronic and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electronic_Diesel_Control plus Bosch automotive aftermarket numbering scheme. Bosch 10-digit part numbers (e.g. 0 281 010 123) use the first 4 digits to encode the product family. Numbers are typically written as 0 XXX XXX XXX.
format: Bosch part number example: 0 281 010 123 → first 4 digits '0281' = EDC diesel engine control. The 4-digit prefix identifies the product family; the remaining 6 digits identify the specific assembly and revision.
notes: Some prefixes are shared across multiple product lines (e.g. injectors and pumps both appear under 0445). Prefixes here cover the most common automotive control modules, sensors, fuel system parts, and ignition components found in EU/US/JP vehicles. ECU 'examples' list common Bosch ECU naming series associated with that prefix.

0204.type: Vacuum brake booster / master cylinder assembly

0242.type: Bosch spark plugs (Super / Platinum / Iridium / Double Platinum)

0258.type: Wideband and narrowband lambda probes (LSU / LSF / LSH)

0261.type: Gasoline engine control unit (port and direct injection)

0265.type: Brake control module — ABS, traction control, stability control

0275.type: Power electronics for hybrid and electric vehicles

0276.type: Stepper motor or DC actuator for idle and throttle

0280.type: Mass airflow sensors, throttle bodies, fuel rails, injectors (gasoline)

0281.type: Diesel engine control unit (Electronic Diesel Control)

0286.type: Power window / sunroof / convenience control module

0332.type: Automotive relays — fuel pump, blower, lighting

0335.type: Coolant, oil, fuel rail pressure and temperature sensors

0341.type: Brake light switch, clutch switch, stop-lamp switch

0342.type: Steering column switches (turn / wiper / lighting stalks)

0344.type: Charge air pressure sensor, intake temp combo sensor

0352.type: Power window lift motors and regulators

0356.type: Front and rear wiper motor assemblies

0390.type: Radiator cooling fan motor / blower motor

0392.type: Electric coolant pump / heater circulation pump

0414.type: Pumpe-Düse / UI / EUI unit injectors (PD VAG, EUI HD)

0444.type: Urea injector, DEF pump, AdBlue dosing module

0445.type: Common rail high-pressure pump (CP1/CP2/CP3/CP4/CP5) and CR injectors (CRI/CRIN piezo and solenoid)

0450.type: Fuel filter housings and integrated modules

0470.type: Bosch VP44 radial-piston distributor pump (e.g. BMW M57, Opel 2.5DTI)

0928.type: ZME / MPROP fuel quantity solenoid (mounted on CP pump)

0986.type: Bosch service line — brake pads/discs, wipers, sensors, batteries (catalog reference prefix)

1457.type: Bosch service parts — fuel filters, oil filters, air filters (aftermarket catalog)

1987.type: Bosch aftermarket catalog — wipers, sensors, brake parts, lambda probes

F00R.type: Service parts for CRI injectors — control valves (F00RJ0xxxx for valve, F00VC01xxx for nozzles)

F00V.type: Common rail injector nozzle / piezo stack service parts

F01R.type: Bosch ECU cores and exchange units (remanufactured)

F026.type: Bosch aftermarket service line (alternative encoding to 0986)

0273004.type: Early ABS 2 hydraulic modulator (BMW E30/E34, Mercedes W124)
